name: speak
description: Reads Claude's replies aloud with a neural voice from Fish Audio or ElevenLabs. In voice mode every answer's Spoken paragraph is read; /speak reads the last reply, speaks text, or asks the model for a spoken summary. Playback controls (pause, back and forward 5 s, stop, replay) sit above the prompt. Needs function hooks (early access) and a terminal with speakers.

engine.title: Voice engine
engine.description: fish (Fish Audio) or elevenlabs. `/speak engine <name>` switches without touching this.

fish_api_key.title: Fish Audio API key
fish_api_key.description: Bearer key for api.fish.audio. Left empty, the FISH_API_KEY environment variable is used.

fish_voice.title: Fish voice id
fish_voice.description: The reference_id of the voice (empty = Fish's default voice). Default is Paula.

fish_model.title: Fish model
fish_model.description: The model header sent to Fish Audio: s2.1-pro-free on the free tier, s2.1-pro or s1 with credit.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: The xi-api-key for api.elevenlabs.io. Left empty, the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable is used.

elevenlabs_voice.title: ElevenLabs voice id
elevenlabs_voice.description: A voice id from your ElevenLabs library. Default is Sarah, a premade voice.

elevenlabs_model.title: ElevenLabs model
elevenlabs_model.description: eleven_flash_v2_5 (fast, half the credits), eleven_multilingual_v2 or eleven_v3.

speed.title: Speech speed
speed.description: 1.0 is normal; 1.05 is a touch brisk. ElevenLabs accepts 0.7 to 1.2.

remote_playback.title: Play on the machine you connected from
remote_playback.description: auto: when this session came in over SSH, play on that client through its own speak mod (it needs an SSH server and the mod installed). off: always play here. Or an SSH host name to always play on.

focus_gate.title: Only read the focused session
focus_gate.description: Inside Herdr, a reply from a session that is not the focused pane is held silently until you switch to it (dropped by a new prompt there, or after 15 minutes).

media_pause.title: Pause media while speaking
media_pause.description: Windows only: pause whatever media apps are playing before the voice starts and resume them after the last queued reply.
